title: Hearthline Current Connection Intent Filter Request
description: A member-directed filter for organizing already eligible discovery options by current connection intent. It is not a binary casual-versus-long-term classifier, a compatibility score request, or a sexual-availability query.
$comment: Forbidden fields include casualOnly, longTermOnly, exactAge, sexualAvailability, relationshipScore, compatibilityScore, conversionLikelihood, proximity, location, safetyScore, riskScore, trustScore, reputationScore, popularityScore, responsePrediction, profileViewData, messageData, health, finances, housing, employment, identity inference, or vulnerability inference.
